input.quote: 14. TERMINATION. Subject to Section 4 hereof, TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: This is a hosting agreement under which TrueLink holds our Client Content and borrower/loan data, but neither § 13 (Term) nor § 14 (Termination) obliges TrueLink to return that data or assist with migration on exit. § 13 only places the burden on us to arrange a new name server within 30 days and a new hosting environment within 60 days, and § 10 contains no return-of-materials mechanic. We therefore inserted the playbook exit clause into § 14: up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, return of our data in a machine-readable format within thirty days, and deletion with written certification thereafter. Because §§ 5 through 30 survive termination under § 24, the inserted obligation will remain enforceable post-termination.

proposal.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance, data return and certified deletion into § 14 (Termination)
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added an orderly exit clause to Section 14 so that, on expiry or termination, TrueLink provides up to six months of transition assistance at its then-current rates, returns our Client Content and borrower and loan data in a machine-readable format within thirty days, and only then deletes and certifies deletion. Our playbook requires data return and migration help on exit; we can accept 90 days of assistance if six months is unworkable.

ops.text: Upon the expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, TrueLink shall (a) at Client's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at TrueLink's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of such expiration or termination, return to Client all Client Content, Client's Intellectual Property, Client Proprietary Information and other Client data (including borrower and loan data) then in TrueLink's possession or control, in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete all such Client Content, Client's Intellectual Property, Client Proprietary Information and Client data from its systems and certify such deletion to Client in writing.
